text:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing quota mismatches when requests hit the REST gateway that transcodes to gRPC. Per-route token counts become fuzzy, especially for model inference routes. Anyone seen this before?

tasha: Is this per-tenant rate/burst or per-model route quotas? Can you paste an example of the transcode mapping?

alex: Per-route (model inference) quotas. When gateway translates POST /v1/models/:id:predict -> MyModelService.Predict the method label used for quota keying disappears in metrics and quota lookup. Example snippet we currently use in the gateway mapping:```yaml
- match: POST /v1/models/:id:predict
  to: MyModelService.Predict
  # currently no header tagging
```

mike: We ran into this too. Two pragmatic paths: 1) tag the inbound HTTP at the gateway with a header like `X-Proto-Method` so quota/metrics can key on it (cheap), or 2) move quota enforcement after the transcode in the gRPC layer so you use the canonical proto method (more correct but needs infra changes).

tasha: Tagging sounds low-friction. But we need to ensure the tag is trustworthy (avoid spoofing) and that the auth layer still validates tenant boundaries.

selena: From the Console/telemetry side: if we add a header tag we should expose both the ingress path and the canonical method in the dashboard so product/infra can compare. Right now charts only show path-based counts.

ops: Proposal: do a canary where the gateway injects `X-Proto-Method` for 5% of traffic for targeted routes and export a new metric label `proto_method` alongside `http_path`. That lets dashboards and alerts compare counts before we change enforcement.

ben: Also watch proto evolution: when transcode drops unknown fields or renames, metric cardinality can spike. Suggest adding a label `protocol=transcoded|grpc` for sampling and retention rules.

alex: Draft rollout plan: 1) Gateway: add header injection for transcode routes (canary 5%). 2) Metrics exporter: add labels `proto_method` and `protocol`. 3) Console: add per-route toggle to prefer `canonical_method` for quota decision (off by default). 4) After 2-4 weeks of telemetry parity, flip enforcement to use proto method for quotas. Thoughts? :thinking:

tasha: SGTM. I'll open a short RFC + change ticket for dashboard work and include a migration checklist.

mike: I'll scope the enforcement change (needs small lib to extract method from gRPC envelope + tests). Ballpark 1-2 weeks of dev plus infra rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary config updated for gateway-tagging (staging), id=canary-20260322 :rocket:

selena: Please add a console note near the toggle: "Switching quota key can cause transient alerts and billing diffs — enable gradual rollout and monitor per-tenant deltas."

ops: We should also add an alert that triggers if proto_method counts differ from http_path counts by >10% for a route during the canary. That'll catch mapping bugs early.

ben: +1 to a safety alert. Also capture exemplar requests (sampled) when diffs exceed threshold for debugging.

alex: Thanks all — I'll file the follow-ups and tag people on the RFC. If anyone has strong objections call them out here. :+1:
